speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what are the key learnings from the process leading to the landmark conservation of Golden Mile Complex in 2021; (b) whether the report on the two-year study on the conservation, or a summary thereof, can be made public; and (c) whether other modernist icons like People's Park Complex can be considered for conservation in view of heritage protection and carbon footprint reduction imperatives.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: It is a symbol of the architectural and engineering ingenuity of Singapore's Pioneer Generation of building professionals, including Gan Eng Oon, William Lim, Tay Kheng Soon, Koh Seow Chuan, Chan Sui Him, Joseph Wang, Woh Hup and many others.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: It encapsulates the people's bold vision and imagination for vibrant, inclusive and high-rise living during Singapore's early nation-building days.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Close engagement with stakeholders, including the wider public, was key.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Following URA's announcement and public exhibition of the proposal, we assessed the feedback received and further worked with the owners to refine the incentive package.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Many members of the public had also written in to MND and URA to express their support for the conservation proposal.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: There is still a learning journey ahead of us for Golden Mile Complex, even after its conservation, as the building owners seek collective sale.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will work with them and the industry to explore viable adaptive reuse outcomes for the building.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also need to strengthen the expertise of our building industry professionals and firms to rehabilitate and conserve such buildings and work with a future developer, if any, to put the building to a meaningful new use.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will closely engage the stakeholders each step of the way.
